cases.title: duplicate ids: occurrences in one list, none across lists

files.f/x/main.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: a
      value: {type: identity}
    - id: a
      value: {type: identity}
    - id: l
      value:
        type: whileloopflow
        modules:
          - id: a
            value: {type: identity}

note: Windmill does not check ids (OF-2), so the program records each repeated id's occurrence in its list, which site paths carry (0011).
